input.title: Unexpected MFA approval prompts
input.description: I received three MFA approval prompts that I did not initiate. I can still sign in, but I denied every prompt and have not approved any access.

expected.summary: An employee received repeated unrequested MFA approval prompts, denied them, and can still access the account.
expected.suggestedReply: Thanks for denying the unexpected prompts. We will review the account activity as a potential security issue and contact you with the next steps.

input.title: Reception printer tray is jammed
input.description: The reception printer cannot use tray two, but tray one prints normally and the second-floor printer is also available. There is no deadline.

expected.summary: A reception printer has one jammed tray, while another tray and a nearby printer remain available.
expected.suggestedReply: Thanks for reporting the printer fault and available alternatives. We will arrange a check of the affected tray.

input.title: Payroll processing system unavailable
input.description: The payroll application will not open for the entire payroll team. Today's payment run has stopped, the submission cutoff is in two hours, and there is no manual workaround.

expected.summary: The entire payroll team cannot open the payroll application, stopping a payment run due in two hours with no workaround.
expected.suggestedReply: Thanks for reporting the payroll outage and cutoff. The service desk will treat this as a critical incident and coordinate immediate investigation.

purpose: Single user blocked by network issue with near deadline

input.title: VPN fails before client presentation
input.description: My VPN connection fails on the company laptop while I am travelling. I need files on the internal drive for a client presentation in two hours, and I have no alternative connection.

expected.summary: A travelling employee cannot connect to the VPN before a client presentation in two hours and has no alternative connection.
expected.suggestedReply: Thanks for explaining the VPN error, deadline, and lack of an alternative. We will investigate the connection and contact you for any required diagnostics.

input.title: How to share a OneDrive training folder
input.description: Please show me how to share a read-only OneDrive folder with my project group before onboarding starts next month. Nothing is blocked today.

expected.summary: An employee wants guidance on sharing a read-only OneDrive folder before onboarding next month, with no current work blocked.
expected.suggestedReply: Thanks for the sharing question and timing. We will provide the approved OneDrive sharing steps and check whether any access restrictions apply.

input.title: Browser closes intermittently
input.description: The approved browser closed twice this afternoon while I was entering data. It reopened successfully, and I do not know whether other people have the same problem.

expected.summary: An approved browser closed twice for one known employee, reopened successfully, and may or may not affect others.
expected.suggestedReply: Thanks for reporting the intermittent browser closures. We will review the application and error details and check whether the issue affects other users.

purpose: Planned access request with temporary cover

input.title: Shared mailbox access for new starter
input.description: A new employee needs access to the Support shared mailbox when they start in five business days. Their team lead can monitor the mailbox until access is ready.

expected.summary: A new starter needs shared-mailbox access in five business days, and the team lead can cover until it is ready.
expected.suggestedReply: Thanks for the access request and start date. We will verify the required authorization and prepare the shared-mailbox access.

purpose: Partial office network degradation with workaround

input.title: Training room Wi-Fi is unstable
input.description: Wi-Fi drops every few minutes for 12 people in the training room. Wired connections work, so the session is continuing, but changing cables is disruptive.

expected.summary: Unstable training-room Wi-Fi affects 12 people, while wired connections allow the session to continue with disruption.
expected.suggestedReply: Thanks for describing the affected group and wired workaround. We will investigate the training-room wireless connection and confirm the next step.
